items.title: Add red/repro coverage for the missing playbook outcome lifecycle
items.context: M0 from playbook-promotion-worker-execution-plan.md. Prove that candidate outcomes need explicit recording and that ordinary story completion must not imply candidate usefulness.

happy.desc: Smoke test demonstrates explicit playbook outcome recording exists and can be asserted as a regression target.

edge.desc: DONE/story completion alone is not accepted as a helped outcome without explicit exposure and verdict source.

adversarial.desc: A candidate helped outcome with exposureMode=none or missing structured verdictSource is rejected.

items.userSees: User sees test output containing "playbook outcome recording rejects helped without concrete exposure" and "DONE success alone does not settle a candidate as helped".

items.title: Implement learning-store outcome ledger primitives with safe write discipline
items.context: M1-M2 foundation. Add append-only outcome records, validation, deterministic IDs or digests, and store-specific locking without changing runtime playbook activation semantics.

happy.desc: Outcome ledger appends a validated record under the shared learning owner root and preserves existing records.

edge.desc: Neutral and unknown outcomes are recorded for observability but do not count as decisive positive helped samples.

adversarial.desc: Malformed playbook ids, empty outcomes, invalid exposure modes, or invalid verdict sources fail closed without corrupting the ledger.

items.userSees: User sees test output containing "outcome ledger preserves existing records" and "neutral/unknown are observability only".

verificationEvidence.command: focused outcome PASS-line check over npm --prefix packages/main run test:experience-layer-playbook
verificationEvidence.note: The focused check confirmed the new outcome assertion PASS line: playbook_outcome_record explicitly appends a non-authoritative ledger row, including ledger creation and candidate digest preservation under the learning owner root.

verificationEvidence.command: focused outcome PASS-line check over npm --prefix packages/main run test:experience-layer-playbook
verificationEvidence.note: The focused check confirmed the new outcome assertion PASS line: neutral/unknown are observability only, not decisive positive helped samples.

verificationEvidence.note: The focused check confirmed the new outcome assertion PASS line: malformed authority/gate claims and inherited outcome fields reject fail-closed without appending ledger rows.

items.title: Expose a host-neutral outcome recording command and smoke coverage
items.context: Add a CLI/handler surface for explicit playbook outcome recording. The command must remain host-neutral and reject candidate helped outcomes without concrete exposure and structured verdict source.

happy.desc: The host-neutral lattice playbook_outcome_record command records an explicit outcome and prints authority=non_authoritative plus gateEvidence=false.

edge.desc: The command leaves candidate status unchanged and does not activate, reject, or surface runtime guidance.

adversarial.desc: No Codex-specific or Claude-specific namespace is introduced for outcome recording; command policy and process facts classify it as audit-only metadata.

items.userSees: User runs lattice playbook_outcome_record and sees Playbook outcome recorded, outcome: <value>, authority: non_authoritative, gateEvidence: false.
